opening.argument: The video is an instructional walkthrough of ordinary YouTube operations. It explicitly explains “how to create a YouTube channel with your phone,” then demonstrates uploading videos, configuring privacy and tags, and using account-recovery and verification settings. The visible screens likewise show public, unlisted, and private visibility options, along with title, description, privacy, tags, and location fields. Although the title mentions earning money online, the material does not promise a guaranteed return, request a fee or investment, or impose an unusual condition for participation. The closing request to “like the video, share the video of all your friends, subscribe to the channel” is a conventional engagement prompt, consistent with an educational technology demonstration.
